jobs.jobDescription:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap.

You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours.

This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level.

Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it.

Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

AI and agentic product

  • Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry.
  • Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products.
  • Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer.
  • Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output and judgment of every product manager through AI-assisted discovery, research, prototyping, and analysis. Product managers have to want this rather than comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Portfolio and operating model

  • Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the whole portfolio: what we build, what we sunset, and how investment is distributed across growth, platform, and operational leverage.
  • Establish the product operating model and the metrics behind it, so decisions are made on evidence and user research rather than opinion.
  • Own the product integration of acquisitions and new products, and act as a senior voice of the customer for both talent and clients.

Team and accountability

  • Decide what a product team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
  • Own resourcing and workforce planning, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
  • Review the product work directly, develop people against a clear bar, and raise it as the organization grows.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Work to get up to speed with how the organization runs, including how our operational frameworks work.
  • Begin building relationships with the CEO, the executive team, and your direct reports.
  • Begin learning Toptal’s platform architecture, marketplace dynamics, internal tooling, and current AI initiatives and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Assess the current state of the Product organization and its AI maturity: its people, its roadmap, its rituals, and where the gaps are, including the team against the bar this role requires.
  • Bring the executive team a product strategy no one asked you for.
  • Become acquainted with the full product portfolio, the company’s goals, and those you will partner with.
  • Establish a shared view with the CEO and the executive team of the company’s priorities and how product supports them.
  • Start collaborating closely with your product teams.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Own the product portfolio, its strategy, and its roadmap, and be executing your own plan with at least one AI-enabled capability already in production and measured.
  • Present your resourcing plan and a clear point of view to the executive team on where product investment should concentrate, what should be deprioritized, and why.
  • Establish or refine the product operating model: planning cadence, prioritization framework, and the metrics the organization will be held to, with the trust of the peers and teams you work with most closely.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Show business impact from AI-enabled products in at least two core surfaces, with the evidence behind it, and visible progress against the top portfolio priorities measured against the metrics you defined.
  • Have the right leadership team in place, with a clear plan to close any remaining gaps.
  • Be inspiring and mentoring the teams you work with, upleveling how the organization brainstorms, collaborates, and executes, and charting a clear path for scaling Product’s impact.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run a product organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with AI leverage embedded in the portfolio and the operating model rather than living in a set of pilots.
  • Have built an exceptional product team doing the best work of their careers, with a record of building impactful products in a timely and elegant fashion.
  • Deliver on your roadmap priorities and promises, with a demonstrable link between product investment and business results, and Product established as a trusted, high-leverage function that the rest of the company plans around.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in a technical discipline (Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems). Masters is strongly preferred.
  • At least 15 years of proven software Product Management experience.
  • At least 8 years of experience leading Product organizations, including experience leading other product leaders (managing managers).
  • Proven ability to raise the level of a product organization through the people you hire and develop.
  • Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, with a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
  • Experience owning an entire product portfolio at a high-growth technology company, with accountability for business outcomes and not solely delivery.
  • Demonstrated success setting product strategy at the executive level and translating it into an executable roadmap across multiple teams and domains.
  • Experience leading AI-enabled products, with a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep, hands-on command of modern AI as a product discipline: agentic architectures, harness and orchestration design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation, along with the economics of running models in production. You have shipped these yourself.
  • Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
  • Growth marketing fluency. You understand acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention well enough to build for them.
  • Experience with marketplace, platform, or two-sided business models is a strong plus.
  • Prior experience working as a Software Engineer is a strong plus.
  • Comfortable working with SQL or spreadsheets to analyze data, as well as conducting research with internal and external users.
  • Ability to creatively craft solutions through data and a user-centric approach.
  • Be meticulous and have a high bar for quality when writing user stories, brainstorming technical approaches, and testing a feature before it is released.
  • Be humble, willing to learn, and do whatever is needed to help us accomplish our goals.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using agile development methodologies with globally distributed teams and the ability to keep up with a fast-paced and global company.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal, and you will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
Location: Berlin, Germany Remote Status: Fully Remote (#LI-Remote)

LivePerson (NASDAQ: LPSN) is a leader in trusted enterprise conversational AI and digital transformation. The world's leading brands use our award-winning Conversational Cloud platform to connect with millions of consumers. We power nearly a billion conversational interactions every month, providing uniquely rich data analytics and safety tools to unlock the power of conversational AI for better business outcomes. Fast Company named LivePerson the #1 Most Innovative AI Company in the world.

Position Overview

The Observability Platform team is building a state-of-the-art observability ecosystem for logging, monitoring, and tracing across cloud and on-premises data centers. We’re looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Lead to lead our Logging and Monitoring initiatives and drive the development of robust, scalable observability solutions within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

In this role, you’ll help build systems that give software engineers greater visibility into the health, performance, and reliability of their applications and services. You’ll oversee a modern observability technology stack that includes Elastic Cloud, Loki, Grafana Labs, and the ELK stack for logging, as well as Zabbix, Captain Hook, and Anodot for metrics, monitoring, and anomaly detection.

You Will: Key Responsibilities & Impact

  • Lead the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of LivePerson’s observability platforms across logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and synthetic monitoring.
  • Own and optimize large-scale observability pipelines processing high volumes of telemetry data daily, leveraging technologies such as Filebeat, Kafka, Logstash, Elastic Cloud, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Labs, Zabbix, Anodot, and related tools.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, Kubernetes-based observability services using Helm, CI/CD pipelines, GCP, GKE, Docker, and cloud-native best practices.
  • Define and establish observability standards, dashboards, alerting frameworks, best practices, and onboarding resources for hundreds of engineering users.
  • Partner closely with DevOps, SRE, Engineering, NOC, Security, and vendor teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and actionable observability solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging observability technologies and drive adoption of modern practices in areas such as OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, anomaly detection, and proactive monitoring.
  • Lead the design and development of an end-to-end Synthetic Monitoring platform, running hundreds of daily synthetic tests on GCP Spot VMs to enable proactive service validation and help engineering teams identify potential issues before they impact customers.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship, driving best practices across observability, DevOps, and cloud engineering.

You Have: Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a related discipline, with a strong background in application development and cloud engineering.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes and containerization technologies, including Docker.
  • Extensive experience with observability and monitoring technologies such as Grafana Labs, Captain Hook, Zabbix, Fluentd, ELK, Kafka, and Prometheus.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, including compute, storage, networking, and related cloud services.
  • Strong programming and scripting skills in one or more languages, such as Go, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
  • Experience designing and operating highly available, scalable, production-grade systems.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and cloud-native development methodologies.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry Collector and Grafana Agent is highly preferred.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical direction across engineering teams.

Our Benefits & Perks

We are committed to supporting the complete well-being, health, financial security, family, and professional growth of our permanent employees.

Financial Security & Growth

  • Additional Pension scheme: deferred pension scheme (LivePerson contributes 20%), ESPP and annual bonus depending on achievements
  • Equipment: Internet and Mobile reimbursement
  • Development: Access to internal professional development resources.

‍‍‍ Time Away & Family Support

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO): Personal time off 33 days , vacation (28 days) and care days (5)
  • Paid Public Holidays.

Volunteering Days: Use them to make a difference in your community. Whether it's a cleanup, supporting a local initiative or holding an “Ehrenamt”, just let us know! We're here to help you create a meaningful impact.

Workplace Flexibility

  • Remote-First Model: Be flexible, work flexibly and from anywhere - no defined working hours or boundaries with offices in Mannheim and Berlin
  • Monthly Connection: Join our monthly connection pizza day in the office!

Why You’ll Love Working Here

As leaders in enterprise customer conversations, we celebrate diversity, empowering our team to forge impactful conversations globally. LivePerson is a place where uniqueness is embraced, growth is constant, and everyone is empowered to create their own success. We're very proud to have earned recognition from Fast Company, Newsweek, and BuiltIn for being a top innovative, beloved, and remote-friendly workplace, and recognized by Gartner as a leader in the Conversational AI space.

Belonging at LivePerson: Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by US Federal, State, or Local law.

Accessibility Commitment

LivePerson is dedicated to the accessibility needs of our applicants and employees. We provide reasonable accommodations to job applicants with disabilities. Applicants who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should inform their recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Important Candidate Notice

The talent acquisition team at LivePerson has recently been notified of a phishing scam targeting candidates applying for our open roles. Scammers have been posing as hiring managers and recruiters in an effort to access candidates' personal and financial information. The phishing scam is not isolated to only LivePerson and has been documented in news articles and media outlets.

Please note that any communication from our hiring teams at LivePerson regarding a job opportunity will only be made by a LivePerson employee with an @liveperson.com email address. LivePerson does not ask for personal or financial information as part of our interview process, including but not limited to your social security number, online account passwords, credit card numbers, passport information, and other related banking information. If you have any questions and or concerns, please feel free to contact recruiting-lp@liveperson.com

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

  • Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
  • Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
  • Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
  • Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

  • Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
  • Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
  • Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

  • Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
  • Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
  • Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
  • Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
  • Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
  • Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
  • Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
  • Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
  • Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
  • Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
  • Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
  • You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
  • Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
  • Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
  • Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information
